events.text: Netherese refugees find asylum in Ascalhorn and Citadel Sundbarr. As the Narrow Sea dries up, the dwarves start to abandon Ascore. The elves allow the refugees to resettle in Ascalhorn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: Elven armies under Coronals Tannivh Irithyl of Cormanthyr and Connak of Rystall Wood break through the defenses of the Twisted Tower and slay the surviving drow slavers. The tower is left in the hands of allied good dark elves, and within a century becomes a great temple to Eilistraee. Drow survivors flee to the Underdark, taking with them the Soldier's Blade of Lord Orym Hawksong, captured after his death at their hands during the fighting.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: The Bey of Runlatha dies in battle against the nalfeshnee Zukothoth near the western border of Delzoun.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: With the death of the Bey of Runlatha, the refugees under his leadership fragment along family lines and revert to a primitive lifestyle. These families evolve into the modern Uthgardt.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: The dwarven Clan Shattered Shield from Citadel Sundbarr flees the Ice Mountains following the approach of renegades from Citadel Felbarr. (Said renegades are believed to be carriers of a plague called the slaying slumber.) Clan Shattered Shield begins a long journey, traveling eastward across the High Ice to Dareth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: The shield dwarven Clan Shattered Shield reaches Dareth and find their gold dwarf cousins under attack by Hoarfaern. They rescue the survivors and retreat to a mountain they dub Mount Sundabar after their former home in Delzoun. They begin construction of a new clanhold and elect Embryn Shattered Shield king.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms

events.text: Netherese refugees settle in the Ice Mountains east of the Coldwood. They name their new home Hartsvale.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: White dragons of Hoarfaern attack Mount Sundabar and Clan Shattered Shield with magic items of unknown, ancient origin but unmistakable potency, smashing the peak and laying waste to the clanhold. The survivors begin a guerrilla war against the dragons and their minion creatures.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: Mornarth Talanthil I, the seventh Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Jesthren Darakh, the Nentyarch of Narfell, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: The dwarves of Delzoun complete Gauntlgrym, and the Netherese arcanist Maerin of Illusk invites Illuskans, Netherese refugees from Runlatha and Sundabar, and dwarves of Clan Goldspire to live in his new city.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: Najaran ophidians summon the Hss'tafi yuan-ti to better their military standing against the Netherese survivor states. The yuan-ti become Najara's ruling caste.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: Members of the Hss'tafi tribe of yuan-ti give the crown Marlspire of Najara to the great naga Terpenzi, creator and first king of Najara, as an offering of fealty.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide, с. 57

events.text: Without the Hss'tafi to guard them, House Se'Sehen seizes their lands.
cites: Serpent Kingdoms, с. 13

events.text: Dareth's dwarves and Hoarfaern's white dragons destroy each other in a massive battle atop the mountain now called Heroes' Height, bringing the kingdom of Dareth to an abrupt end.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: The famed explorer Dienere Falconholfer is believed to have perished this year while exploring easternmost Nyanza Lake.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 79,114

events.text: Tallos Talanthil II, who would later become Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Hu Ling Do of T'u Lung writes the Hsao Chronicles, encouraging a strong following of the Way in the south.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: After several raids and a short siege, Zazesspur is conquered and taken over by the Tethyrian tribes and renamed Fort Karlag, after their warlord.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24

events.text: Kobold sappers, after working for centuries, finally break into the netherese outpost known as Blister. Thousands of kobolds overrun the few remaining netherese soldiers and both orcs and goblins flood back into their ancestral homeland, only to discover their fertile plains replaced by the Anauroch desert.
cites: Dungeon 88: The Door from Everywhere, с. 23

events.text: In thanks for their aid during the Shadow Wars, Coronal Tannivh Irithyl of Cormanthyr allows a population of good drow to settle in the woods east of Cormanthor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 49

events.text: Circa: Gorothir, most favored of Shar's servants, ascends to become high priest of her faith, completely dominating the church.
cites: Prayers from the Faithful, с. 33

events.text: Garthelaun Darakh, a future Nentyarch of Narfell, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: King Saldrinar of Westgate disappears under unknown circumstances.
Myratma is conquered by the Tethyrians. They rename the city Artrimmar.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41

events.text: Saldrinar, the King of Westgate, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: Netherese shadows break free of their masters, regain their identities, and begin attacking Netherese undead all across Faerûn.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 50

events.text: The snake god Sseth found the yuan-ti empire of Serpentes, lying within the ancient ruins of the sarrukh empire of Mhairshaulk.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 50

events.text: Serpentes quickly makes war on the humans of Lapaliiya, which has suffered from the Empire Plague.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 50

events.text: Three black dragons fly down from the north and attack the city of Westgate. The wizard-king Mather "Wyrmshroud" is killed defending it from them.
Westgate's city guard captain, Glaurath, ascends the throne.
In the Armridge Mountains, the Sossrim defeat an army of frost giants led by Orbrud of the Pines. Arkhan Tallos of Raumathar sends warriors borne by wind elementals to aid them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 50

events.text: The Sossrim pledge fealty to Raumathar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 50

events.text: Heldakar Darakh, the Nentyarch of Narfell, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: The city of Karse is founded by the Cult of Karsus, lying deep in the High Forest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: What was once Netheril's breadbasket, Specie, is abandoned to the encroaching Anauroch desert.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 88

events.text: Luszoch Vesahliir becomes coronal of Aryselmalyr and commences the first tour of his empire in Serôs. He makes a number of veiled threats to all of Aryselmalyr's allied and subject powers, raising suspicions against him. All sides discreetly prepare for war, and wait for Vesahliir to make a wrong step.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: After a month-long siege, the Calishite garrison town of Calimaronn on the River Wurlur is taken by the Tethyrians. They rename the town Ithmong and the river Ith, after the chieftain and the clan that led them to victory.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41

events.text: Warlord Karlag falls in the Battle for Calimarron.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24

events.text: King Glaurath of Westgate dies of heartstop.
Like his king before him, Westgate's city guard captain, Thorndaer, ascends the throne.

The emperor of Shou Lung insults the Emperor Gokami of Wa by insinuating that Wa is responsible for the high levels of piracy in the seas between the two nations. Gokami orders that the messengers be executed, leading to the start of the Omi War.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4
Test of the Samurai, с. 5

events.text: The yuan-ti of the Sseradess and Sauringar tribes enslave the Thinguth people and spread them over greater Thindol (partially claimed by Samarach).
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The people of Tethyr gain their independence from Calimshan.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 268
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The vampire Orlak and a small army of mercenaries capture the city of Westgate in a single night.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 268
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The inhabitants of Karse quarrel amongst themselves. This culminates in the destruction of the city as the people abandon it.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The Xothol arcane college is closed.
The lich arcanist Wulgreth of Netheril settles in the ruins of Karse.
Tallos Talanthil I, the eighth Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Followers of Anachtyr slay the great wyrm Rivenaurlgoth the Darkly Pious in his lair in the Marching Mountains. Afterwards they gilded his skull and carved the Myth of the Four Rivers into the teeth.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 9

events.text: Coronal Luszoch Vesahliir, the despotic ruler of Aryselmalyr and the Serôs empire, is poisoned by his own senior general and lifelong friend, in order to preserve the empire and peace. Vesahliir is succeeded by his son Esahl, a pacifistic Dukar. Esahl promises reforms in Aryselmalyr and eventually self-governance for the other races.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Mornarth Talanthil II, who would later become Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Responding to piracy in the Celestial Sea, the sixth Emperor Chin of the Hai Dynasty of Shou Lung proclaims the Scattering of Winds, a demand that the warlords of Wa swear allegiance to Shou Lung emperor. Wa declines, and Wanese emperor Gokami gathers a fleet.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The city of Almorel is founded by the Raumathari.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Emperor Gokami executes all but one of the emissaries from Shou Lung, triggering the start of the Omi War.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4

events.text: Expecting a Shou Lung invasion, the warlords of Wa begin fortifying their coasts and constructing castles. The ninja Fukio is sent to Shou Lung to act as a spy for Wa.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Eye of the Law Kaian discovers the palace of the Sea Lord and teaches him the Path of Enlightenment.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4

events.text: Tallos Talanthil III, who would later become Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: The bladelord psiocracy of Jhaamdath is disposed in a bloody coup, and is replaced by the militant Emperor Dharien. The emperor orders the construction of a great navy on the Sea of Fallen Stars.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Members of the church of Auppenser protest events in Jhaamdath. Hundreds of dissenters are arrested and imprisoned. Several are accused of treason and executed. The majority are subjected to mind-altering psionics that instil loyalty to the emperor. The crackdown mutes the church's protests, and many of the faithful go into hiding.
Jhaamdathans logging in the Chondalwood feud with the native elves. Over the next two decades, Jhaamdathan armies hunt, kill, and massacre the elves.

The Omi War escalates when Shou Lung assaults a number of strongholds in Wa with a fleet of 100,000 ships and seizes control of the north and south of the country. The sixth Emperor Chin of Shou Lung sends his land forces and combined fleets against the central portion. The northern and southern daimyo of Wa betray their nation and allow the Shou Lung to take over the garrisons. Only General Yoshibei's shrewdness saves the city of Nakamaru from the Shou Lung forces.
cites: Blood of the Yakuza, с. 4
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: In the last battle between Shou Lung and Wa, the Shou land forces overwhelm those of Wa, but their fleet is grounded on reefs concealed by wu jen working for the Wa warlords.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The sixth Emperor Chin of the Hai Dynasty of Shou Lung and his court are killed in the fleet's destruction, ending the Hai Dynasty. Rourke, a foreigner piloting the emperor's ship, rescues the Emblems of Imperial Authority and returns to the Imperial City. But Rourke is killed and the Emblems disappear. The Black Cycle of Years commences in Shou Lung.

In T'u Lung, the Black Cycle is characterized by frequent invasions, both from the south and from minor lords in the north, and natural disasters, such as blights, crop failures, and the flooding of the Fenghsintzu. Order collapses, except where local feudal lords still hold sway. The Wai and Yang clans begin to rise to prominence.
A truce is signed between General Yoshibei of Wa and the Shou governor of the northern part of the island. Yoshibei installs himself as warlord of the Wa province.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Over the next century, Wa suffers under wars between the nobles of Wa and the governors from Shou Lung. Over time, Shou governors of Wa assimilate into native culture, and have more allegiance to the Emperor of Wa than to that of Shou Lung.
In this period, the Order of the Snake gains influence in all levels of Wa's governments.

In Jhaamdath, Emperor Dharien commands the army to seize udoxias still controlled by the church of Auppenser. Hundreds of faithful citizens stand before the temples, preventing the soldiers from entering. After a brief standoff, Dharien and his troops back down.
Construction of Citadel Adbar is completed.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 35
Lost Empires of Faerûn, с. 84
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The Giants in Grey are sighted all over Shou Lung.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: In Shou Lung, blight afflicts the coastal lowlands and crops fail.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Yannos Darakh, the Nentyarch of Narfell, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: A powerful earthquake strikes the North, cutting the passage between the ruins of Tzindylspar and the surface but opening new ways into the Fardrimm, a tunnel network between the North and the Anauroch.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: During the Black Cycle of Years, a crime family in the city of Kai Shan in Shou Lung takes control of the city and declares independence.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Led by members of the church of Auppenser, the city of Gharrent attempts to secede from the Jhaamdathan empire. Emperor Dharien declares it rebellious and launches an immediate invasion. All suspect rebels are put on trial for treason and publicly executed. Dharien removes the city's udoxias and hides it.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: Princess Darseera vanishes without a trace at night from the gardens of her father's keep in the Purple Hills. The ballad "Lost Princess Road" is written about her disappearance.
cites: Dragon 268: The New Adventures of Volo: Lost Princess Road, с. 88

events.text: Ilithkar Darakh, a future Nentyarch of Narfell, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: A Durpari trader named Satama begins preaching of the Adama.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: On Midsummer Night, retaliating against Jhaamdathan aggression, elven high mages of Nikerymath conjure a gigantic tsunami to inundate Jhaamdath and wipe out the Twelve Cities of the Sword. The tsunami reshapes the land into the Vilhon Reach.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 19
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51
Serpent Kingdoms, с. 94

events.text: The tsunami also destroys the sea elf city of Coryselmal, resulting in the downfall of the Aryselmalyr Empire. The subject states of Aryselmalyr are freed and fight for control of Serôs. This triggers the Sixth Serôs War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 51

events.text: The Anauroch makes the lands around the Netherese town of Sepulcher worthless for fishing or logging.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 86

events.text: Satama, a Durpari trader and prophet of the Adama, becomes Maharajah of Durpar.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Circa: Following the fall of Jhaamdath and the loosening of its grip on the Arnaden lands of the Lake of Steam, Syl-Pasha Faud yn Orun el Evyrtaan leads to Calimshan several small areas and towns of the region.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Tallos Talanthil II, the Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: General Halflar Audark of Cormanthyr, at the head of a brigade of three hundred, storms the lair of the wyrm Venominhandar ("Venom") and slays what turns out to be the female of a mated pair. While also driving off most of its minions, the band is slain to an elf when the male appears.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 99

events.text: Emerging from a portal near what would later be Alaghôn in Turmish, Tyr, god of justice, leads an army of two hundred celestial archons in the Procession of Justice. They cross the Vilhon Reach to pacify the lawless remnants of the fallen empire of Jhaamdath. Valigan Thirdborn, a lesser deity of anarchy, is killed in the fighting.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: In Shou Lung, the Impossible Palace of the Silver Domes reappears for two weeks, then disappears again.

links.t: Impossible Palace of the Silver Domes

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Rheligaun Darakh, a future Nentyarch of Narfell, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: During the Procession of Justice in the Vilhon Reach, Tyr's deeds and sacrifices catch the attention of Ilmater, previously an obscure deity, and the two ally.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: The prominent Veldorn tribe founds the Kingdom of Veldorn between the Golden Water and the Curna Mountains. They name Vaelan as their capital.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: After fifteen years of the Sixth Serôs War, anger against the sea elves of Aryselmalyr begins to wane. Surviving sea elves protect themselves with magic, High Magic, and the aid of the Dukars, against rebellious koalinth, merfolk, locathah, and morkoth.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Mornarth Talanthil III, who would later become Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: The Copper Demon of Tros, brutal tyrant of western Shou Lung, is killed by the Seven Heroes and the Seven Nonmen, including Wo Mai.

links.t: Seven Heroes and the Seven Nonmen

events.text: Following seventeen years of continual skirmishing and conflict between the powers of Serôs in the Sixth Serôs War, and the sahuagin taking advantage of the chaos to make a comeback at the Pillars of the Trident, the Dukar Orders of Jhimari and Numos attempt to re-establish peace and order by founding their own kingdom at Myth Nantar, known as Nantarum. This triggers the Second Dukars' War.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: The Procession of Justice in the Vilhon Reach comes to an end.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Darrom Ithal, future first king of Tethyr, is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 28
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 83

events.text: The tribes of Gundavar unite and found the Kingdom of Gundavar, under the rule of Rajah B'hesti I.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Garthelaun Darakh, the Nentyarch of Narfell, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 81

events.text: In fear of their lives, three whole clans of sea elves flee from Serôs. They journey to the elven nation of Cormanthyr and settle in Lake Sember.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Calimshan recaptures the communities of Ithmong (formerly Calimaronn) and Artrimmar (formerly Myratma) and enslaves over a third of their populations—5,500 slaves in total. Many are are put to work on the Pasha's Palace, while the 1,480 warriors among them are forced to be gladiators in the Djen Arena.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24–25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41
Calimport, с. 18

events.text: Durpar, Gundavar, and Veldorn make a formal alliance.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Calimport achieves its greatest size and population, with over 75,000 proper citizens, and remains the biggest and busiest port in Faerûn for 800 years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 52

events.text: Wo Mai, a noble who claims descent from Nung Fu, retrieves the Emblems of Imperial Authority from the crypts under the Imperial City of Shou Lung. He rallies the armies and nobles to his cause and puts down rebellions in the outer provinces of Shou Lung. Wo Mai is coronated the first Emperor Chin of the Kao Dynasty, ending the Black Cycle of Years.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: The Shou Lung empire defeats the last of the tribes invading its south and reestablishes control there. The Black Leopard Cult, a secret society that helps peasants, is forced out by the conflict.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: Eltargrim, the champion warrior of Cormanthor, begins to learn magic and eventually High Magic. This marks the beginning of the Sixth Rysar of Cormanthor.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: Hui-Po, a wu jen adviser to the emperor of Wa, while attempting to create a portal escape-route for the emperor, accidentally transports himself to Qui, a mysterious place. He returned to Wa with bundles of silk, and fashions four scarves of transport to Qui. However, before he can tell anyone, an attempted coup leaves Hui-Po and his assistants dead. The scarfs, unused and their functions unknown, are forgotten and eventually disappear.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: The drow city of Chaulssin is captured and enslaved by shadow dragons of Clan Jaezred. Over the coming centuries, the drow of Chaulssin are turned into shadow creatures or replaced by shadow dragon–descended drow creatures, while Chaulssin itself slips into the Plane of Shadow.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 57

events.text: In alliance with elves, Chief Clovis Ithal II of the Tethyrian clans leads an attack to retake Ithmong but is killed in a battle known as the Ithmong Slaughter. Darrom Ithal, his son, succeeds him and continues the assault, seizing the city and massacring all Calishites inside and for two miles around.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24–25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41
Calimport, с. 18

events.text: Darrom Ithal unites the Tethyrian clans under his rule.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24–25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41

cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24–25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41

events.text: Corin Ithal, son of Clovis II and brother to Darrom, is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24–25

events.text: In Serôs, the city-state of Nantarum is besieged by merfolk led by Ristan when the city's mythal emits a strange humming and magical energy discharges in the surrounding sea. The people of Nantarum die mysteriously and the merfolk take the city. They discover one survivor, the sea elf Dukar leader Yupal Narlis, driven mad. Thirty contrite Dukar and nobles are found transformed into coral statues along the avenue to the Council Academy of the Dukars. The Second Dukars' War is ended.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: The Sixth Serôs War comes to an end.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: Following the war, Serôs is dominated by the shalarin of As'arem, the morkoth Theocracy of the Deep Ones, and the merfolk kingdom of Hmurrath. Hmurrath's rise marks the beginning of the Third Epoch.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: Mornarth Talanthil II, the Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Tallos Talanthil IV, who would later become the ninth Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Tethyrian barbarian clans and elven allies, led by Chieftain Darrom Ithal capture Myratma for a second time from the Calishites in the Battle of the Purple Marches.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41
Calimport, с. 18

events.text: The white dragon, Ufloq, awakens in its lair in the Olyniak Crevasse of the Great Glacier. Several dozen Nakulutiun witnessed the event, attracted to the crevasse by the loud rumbling. Many were promptly devoured by the hungry dragon. This is the only recorded sighting of Ufloq.
cites: The Great Glacier, с. 7

events.text: Darrom Ithal becomes king of Tethyr, and Calimshan finally grants it its independence. It is the beginning of the Calendar of Tethyreckoning, known as the Founding Year.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 25
Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 41
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: King Darrom Ithal of Tethyr makes the half-elf Saraala Tarseth his queen. This act helps unify the Tethyrian clans as well as improves relations with the elves of the Forest of Tethir.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 25

events.text: Prince Silvam Ithal of Tethyr, the second son of King Darrom and Queen Saraala, is born.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 28
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 83

events.text: Vayloss Talanthil IV, who would later become the tenth Sorcerer–Arkhan of the Talanthil Dynasty in Raumathar, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 82

events.text: Corin Ithal becomes chieftain of Clan Ithal.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 25

events.text: The last Coronal of Illefarn, Syglaeth Audark, is killed by drow raiders from Jhachalkhyn, a drow city below the Neverwinter Woods.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 53

events.text: Venominhandar's mate is finally slain by Jassin Aunglor, a moon elf warrior, who caves in the dragon's lair on top of both of them.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 99

events.text: Tethyr's first ever crown prince, Darrom Ithal II, older brother to Silvam Ithal dies of a fever.

events.text: King Inrath Mirandor of Impiltur is slain in battle against a group of marauding hill giants.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 78

events.text: Following the death of his father, Inrath Mirandor II is crowned the new king of Impiltur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 78

events.text: Wishing to add Rashemen to its empire, Mulhorand marches a huge army through the Gorge of Gauros. The Witches of Rashemen summon nature spirits to their defence, who fight with the berserkers to force the Mulhorandi back.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Vhloar's reign as ruler of the sahuagin kingdom of Aleaxtis comes to an end and they are succeeded by K'Sahln.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 185

events.text: King Nilshan II of Tethyr orders an attack on the pirates of the Nelanther Isles. The flagships of both fleets are destroyed.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 25

events.text: Black Alaric is presumed dead as his ship, the Talon, is scuttled.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 25

events.text: Alaghôn is founded by Chondathan settlers on the southern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars. It is the first recorded settlement in the area that will eventually become the nation of Turmish.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59
Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide, с. 184

events.text: Talona kills Kiputytto.
cites: Netheril: Empire of Magic: The Winds of Netheril, с. 12

events.text: Divine plagues cause the death of the entire population of the Netherese realm of Asram. The plague was sent by Talona.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Thunn, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: The city of Starmantle was founded.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 5

events.text: Ryndarth Soleilon I and Ryndarth II, both Kings of Westgate, die.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: Ashtukzu II, a future King of Westgate, is born.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: Tethyrian Clans Bardson, Ithal, and Rivarrow remove all ogre tribes from the lands between the Sulduskoon River and the River Ith.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 28

events.text: Ri'ara'tup becomes the first eadar (emperor) of the shalarin empire of As'arem.
cites: Sea of Fallen Stars, с. 186

events.text: An unknown faction adds poison to ink and quills in all cities across the Lands of Intrigue and as far north as Baldur's Gate, leading to the so-called Plague of Scholars.
cites: Calimport, с. 19

events.text: With imperial ambitions, Illusk expands to the south and east.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Illusk's imperial expansion is halted in the south by the elves of Iliyanbruen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Lord Halueth Never leads the elves of Iliyanbruen to victory over Illusk. Skirmishing between the two continues however.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: The Circle of Flames cabal forms in Cormanthor. It comprises many retired ﻿Akh'Faer wizards and their apprentices.
cites: Cormanthyr: Empire of the Elves, с. 36
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Tethyr's Clan Fyrson has a civil war, pitting the royalists led by Tavis Fyrson II against the traitors led by his brother Volsun. Volsun wins, killing Tavis, and later in the year captures and ransoms the heirs of Clan Bormul and Clan Karlag, declaring Clan Fyrson rebels against the crown.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 28

events.text: Volsun Fyrson, nephew of Black Alaric, takes up his uncle's moniker and comes to lead the Nelanther pirates, merging his clan's resources with theirs.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 28

events.text: Helbrester is obliterated with magic used by the liches Thakloamur and Mingaudorr. The outlaw Tethyrian Clan Fyrson and Nelanther pirates then plunder the ruins.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Ashtukzu I, the King of Westgate, dies.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 85

events.text: Faerlthann Obarskyr, first king of Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 76

events.text: Yvonnel Baenre becomes matron mother of House Baenre, beginning a reign that will last nearly a millennia and a half.
cites: Menzoberranzan: City of Intrigue, с. 35

events.text: Members of the Tethyrian royal family are slain by pirates. The murders were planned by Syl-Pasha Akkabar el Shoon, but his efforts to frame the murders on the Rundeen merchant cabal fail.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: The city of Ithalyr falls to Calishite forces and the capital is moved to Fort Karlag. Within a month, Amahl Shoon I, younger brother of Queen Arhymeria, arrives and is made king of Tethyr by the Calishite military and advisers. He restores the name of the ancient Calishite city to Zazesspur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59
Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 24

events.text: Peace is made between the humans of Illusk and the elves of Iliyanbruen. The River Mirar is marked as the border between their realms.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: King Amahl I of Tethyr dies of poisoning, ordered by his grandfather Syl-Pasha Akkabar el Shoon of Calimshan.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Tethyr, с. 30
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Amahl II, Amahl I's nephew, succeeds him as king.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Clan Ithal's lands are scourged by Calishite forces.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Following a year and a half of war against Tethyr, Calishite forces destroy Ithmong and nearly wipe out Clan Ithal. Tethyr is defeated.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: In Greengrass, King Amahl II of Tethyr swears allegiance to Syl-Pasha Akkabar el Shoon of Calimshan. With rule over both nations, this is the beginning of the Shoon Imperium.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Akkabar the Younger dies in a tavern brawl in Memnon. He is the eldest grandson of Syl-Pasha Akkabar el Shoon of Calimshan and his proclaimed heir, and is also the father of King Amahl II of Tethyr. When the killing is found to be a revenge attack by Tethyrian clansmen, Tethyr suffers badly.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 59

events.text: Construction begins on a new capital for the Shoon Imperium, called Shoonach. The ruins of Ithmong are robbed for building material, and Tethyrian supporters of Clan Ithal are enslaved to transport the stone to Shoonach over a decade.
